name: Fresh Canna Live Resin Brush | Strawberry Cough
description: Breathe in the sweet, fruity rush of Fresh Canna’s 2G Live Resin Concentrate Brush – Strawberry Cough, a classic sativa loved for its smooth smoke and uplifting energy. This precision brush applicator makes it simple to infuse dabs, prerolls, blunts, or bowls with pure, terpene-rich live resin. With ripe strawberry, citrus, and subtle earthy spice notes, this strain delivers an instant cerebral buzz that enhances mood, focus, and creativity, keeping you feeling refreshed and inspired.
